subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw accept unused core agent termination and GSAR primitives now, or keep the linked feature issue as the design tracker until a production sessions_send and trusted-evidence integration is ready?
rationale: The current branch deliberately removes production wiring and adds allowlisted core files, so automation can repair mechanics but cannot decide whether this dormant API belongs in core now.

options.title: Repair Mechanics, Then Owner Review
options.body: Fix the stale import and demo/proof mismatches first, then have agents/runtime owners explicitly decide whether the dormant primitives should merge as groundwork.

options.title: Require Production Integration
options.body: Ask for a narrow owner-approved sessions_send integration with a trusted evidence contract before accepting the new core surface.

options.title: Pause On The Tracker
options.body: Leave the linked feature issue open as the design discussion and close or defer this branch if unused core primitives are not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Repair Mechanics, Then Owner Review
recommendation.body: Fix the stale import and demo/proof mismatches first, then have agents/runtime owners explicitly decide whether the dormant primitives should merge as groundwork.
